# Screen effects

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/screen-effects.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The full-screen effects scripts call for: the six effects `ScreenQueueEffect(type, seconds)` queues, the
thirteen looks `CfgScrFx` configures (each a screen tint and a motion-blur strength the screen blends to) and
the four effect layers the weather bindings start and end. Every view has its own screen-effects manager
([Graphics: screen effects](../research/graphics.md#screen-effects)).

!!! info "What is complete"

    All six queue types, thirteen look slots and four layers are listed. The queue's handlers and the layers'
    tags are read from the executable; the looks' numbers are the `CfgScrFx` calls of `config_preload2.lua` (looks 3
    and 4 have none). Who uses looks 1, 6, 11 and 12 is not traced, nor what looks 0, 3, 4 and 8 are for.

23 entries. Data: `research/references/screen-effects.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | Our stable id: `queue-<n>` (a `ScreenQueueEffect` type), `look-<n>` (a `CfgScrFx` slot) or `layer-<n>` (an effect layer). |
| `kind` | str | | `queue`, `look` or `layer`. |
| `number` | int | | The number the binding takes: effect type, slot or layer. |
| `handler` | hex | | Queue: the code the effect's jump-table entry runs, read from the executable. |
| `class` | str | | Layer: the class tag its object is allocated with, read from the executable. |
| `colour` | list | | Look: `{r, g, b, a}` (0-255) `CfgScrFx` gives it (colour form). |
| `in_ms` | int | | Look: milliseconds to blend in (slot `+0x10`, kept in seconds). |
| `out_ms` | int | | Look: milliseconds to blend out (slot `+0x14`). |
| `value` | int | | Look: the colour form's fifth number (slot `+0x18`, the motion-blur alpha). |
| `hold_ms` | int | | Look: milliseconds kept as 60 Hz frames (slot `+0x20`; look 5: the pulse's hold). |
| `value2` | int | | Look: the colour form's seventh number (slot `+0x1c`). |
| `strength` | int | | Look 5: the pulse's strength (manager `+0x148`). |
| `factors` | list | | Look 5: the two floats of the numeric form (manager `+0x14c`, `+0x150`). |
| `set_by` | str | | Who switches to it or makes it. |
| `bindings` | list | | Layer: the bindings that start and end it. |
| `calls` | int | | Script calls: `ScreenQueueEffect` with the type, or the layer's bindings. |
| `scripts` | list | | The scripts that make those calls (at most six). |
| `meaning` | str | yes | What it shows, in our words. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
